'''DX-M2''' was an advanced [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] who was part of [[Strike Team Oricon]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] unit tasked with battling the forces of the [[Dread Masters]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]]. DX-M2 was equipped with a number of programming modules, including geo-scanning, neurobiologist, messenger, rescue, demolitionist, [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]], and warlord modules. He worked with [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Tanye Trila]] to oversee the remains of the strike team after their disastrous approach to Oricon.

==Behind the scenes==
DX-M2 appears in the Republic storyline for the Daily Area of [[Oricon]] that was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.4.<ref name="Day of Dread" />
